title: Reset your password
answer: Use 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page. The reset link expires after 30 minutes.

title: Export data to CSV
answer: Open Reports, choose a date range, then select Export > CSV. Exports over 100k rows are emailed.

title: App crashes on launch
answer: Update to the latest version, then clear the app cache under Settings > Storage. If it persists, collect logs and escalate.

title: Connect an integration
answer: Create an API token under Settings > Developers and paste it into the integration. Tokens can be rotated at any time.
